atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Use the `@theme` directive to define your project's custom design tokens, like fonts, colors, and breakpoints. Supports the `inline`, `static`, and `reference` modifiers.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Use the `@source` directive to explicitly specify source files that aren't picked up by Tailwind's automatic content detection. Use `@source not` to exclude paths and `@source inline(...)` to safelist utilities.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Use the `@utility` directive to add custom utilities to your project that work with variants like `hover`, `focus` and `lg`.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Use the `@variant` directive to apply a Tailwind variant to styles in your CSS. To define a custom variant, use `@custom-variant`.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Use the `@custom-variant` directive to add a custom variant in your project.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Use the `@apply` directive to inline any existing utility classes into your own custom CSS.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Use the `@reference` directive to import your main stylesheet for reference without actually including the styles, so `@apply` and `@variant` work in Vue or Svelte style blocks and CSS modules.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Use the `@config` directive to load a legacy JavaScript-based configuration file. Exists for compatibility with Tailwind CSS v3.x.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Use the `@plugin` directive to load a legacy JavaScript-based plugin, either a package name or a local path. Exists for compatibility with Tailwind CSS v3.x.
